text:
nora: Observed a small but steady rise in 'unknown' tenant buckets after the new routing-policy optimizer landed in proxy-optimizer v3 canary. Not huge but reproducible.

kevin: timeline? which canary hosts?

nora: rolled to optimizer-pool-3 at 03:18 UTC. spike starts ~03:19 and persists for ~20m.

sanjay: logs show route hint header present but parsed into empty route object in optimizer step. suspect parsing change to strict semicolon split.

maya: SDKs send header as "tenant=org; quota_group=2" sometimes with extra spaces. Did optimizer tighten whitespace rules?

sanjay: yes, optimizer v3 uses strict split on ';' then expects key=value no trimming. previous versions trimmed.

kevin: impact: quota attribution drops when optimizer returns null route. How many requests? ~1.8% of traffic during canary.

nora: mitigation options: 1) revert optimizer config, 2) config patch to be tolerant, 3) SDK change to canonicalize header. revert is simplest short-term.

maya: SDK owners prefer server-side tolerant change. We can't force all clients to update quickly.

kevin: let's patch optimizer to trim whitespace and accept both tenant and tenant_id keys. low-risk config change. roll out to canary then prod.

ci-bot: added integration test for header parsing with varied whitespace and quoted values.

ops-bot: created INC-2026-0440 for routing-policy-optimizer whitespace regression.

[40m later]

kevin: patched and canaried tolerant parser. attributed tokens returned to baseline.

nora: follow-ups: add parser fuzz tests, update release notes calling out stricter parsing that was reverted, and add Console telemetry metric "route_parser_failure" sampled for top 1% routes. owners: sanjay(parser), maya(sdks), nora(console).

sanjay: will own postmortem and add unit tests.

maya: will add SDK canonicalizer util and an opt-in flag to emit canonical header until customers upgrade.

kevin: thanks team. recommend we add a lint rule in CI to catch header formatting in SDK tests to prevent regression.

nora: agreed. closing after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
